title: Antique Brass Towel Ring 6-Inch, Solid Brass Wall Mount, Concealed Screws, Foxtrot Collection, Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping hand towels on the counter—this wall-mounted towel ring keeps a towel ready right where you need it at the sink in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This bathroom towel ring (also called a towel holder or towel rack) features a round 6-inch diameter ring and concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look. Built with solid brass for enduring everyday use, it coordinates with matching Foxtrot collection pieces for a cohesive set of designer bathroom hardware and statement bath accessories.

- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose long-lasting strength with solid brass and brass construction
- Style-forward coordination with the Foxtrot collection and matching Foxtrot accessories

- Weight capacity: 10 lb

- Assembled in the U.S.A.
